question.text: RBI conducts weekly auctions for Treasury Bills of which tenors?

explanation.text: The Logic: RBI conducts weekly auctions for three tenors of T-bills: 91 days, 182 days, and 364 days. The Trap: 14-day T-bills do exist but are not available for public consumption, so they are not part of the regular weekly public auctions. Note: The other tenor combinations listed (30/90/180 day or a 730-day option) are not the tenors at which RBI conducts T-bill auctions.
